items.title: Oil prices jump 7% after Trump says U.S. will hit Iran hard
items.description: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.

items.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over law to ban 'nudify' apps
items.description: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota

items.title: Todd Blanche attorney general nomination on edge as Cornyn questions Trump-IRS settlement
items.description: Sen. John Cornyn says the DOJ has failed to satisfy his concerns about a deal to shield President Donald Trump and others from IRS tax audits.

items.title: Humana tops quarterly estimates, maintains profit outlook as medical costs stay in line
items.description: Humana maintained its 2026 adjusted profit outlook of at least $9 per share, which some analysts called a "disappointment" amid high expectations for insurers.

items.title: Jim Cramer sees opportunity to snap up more shares of this chipmaker
items.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

items.title: Microsoft is set to report earnings after the bell, and all eyes are on its spending plans
items.description: Investors are looking to see if Microsoft follows Alphabet in raising its capital spending plans

items.title: How a 40-year-old father launched a $1.6 billion-a-year meat snacks empire from a bankrupt Wisconsin business
items.description: Jack Link turned a bankruptcy into an opportunity to build a beef jerky empire. Four decades later, Link Snacks brings in more than $1 billion in annual sales.

items.title: Warren, Schiff urge SEC to probe Trump Media's paid service giving faster access to Trump's posts
items.description: Trump has frequently posted policy announcements or other newsworthy information on Truth Social that have sent global markets hurtling up or down.

items.title: Meta reports second-quarter results after the close
items.description: Meta continues to see healthy growth from online ads, but investors are looking for more clarity on the company's plans to diversify.

items.title: YES Network, MSG Networks to exit Gotham app for DAZN streaming service
items.description: The regional sports networks that air games for local New York and New Jersey teams, including MLB's Yankees and NHL's Rangers, will have a new streaming home.

items.title: Secret Service 'illegally' surveilled Comey in Trump ‘8647’ threat case: Court filing
items.description: Ex-FBI Director James Comey says he's the subject of vindictive prosecution for posting on Instagram of a photo of seashells forming the numbers "8647."

items.title: Warren probes Pentagon program to hire highly paid private sector workers
items.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., said she is concerned about a Pentagon program to pay high salaries to Wall Street recruits.

items.title: Why shareholders are suing Novo Nordisk over next-generation weight-loss drug
items.description: Investors claim Novo Nordisk misled the market about CagriSema's tolerability, after disappointing clinical trial results wiped billions off its market cap.

items.title: FIFA is embroiled in a $20 billion World Cup controversy. Here's what's going on
items.description: UEFA – European soccer's governing body – accused FIFA of "crossing a line" and said the tournament is not its to sell.

items.title: Procter & Gamble revenue misses estimates as volume stays unchanged
items.description: Procter & Gamble reported quarterly earnings per share that topped Wall Street's estimates, but its revenue fell short of expectations.

items.title: Nike was once China's sneaker king. Here's why its sales have fallen 30%
items.description: China was once Nike's fastest-growing region but the company has lost relevance among young consumers and ceded market share to smaller, domestic brands.

items.title: Trump says U.S. will give Iran a 'beating' after surprise attack
items.description: Centcom in a post on X said that the attack originated from Iran, but all missiles were intercepted.

items.title: JPMorgan, Schwab and UBS manage millions in Trump's $858 million investment portfolio
items.description: JPMorgan, Schwab, UBS and Stephens Inc. are among the firms that have managed Trump's fortune in accounts worth at least $858 million, a CNBC analysis found.

items.title: Ukraine has found a new pressure point in Russia’s wartime economy
items.description: Ukraine's drone attacks on Russia's biggest online retailer, Wildberries, have ratcheted up the pressure on Moscow's wartime economy.

items.title: Does the 4% retirement rule still work? New research points to another strategy to maximize income
items.description: When it comes to retirement income, diversifying with partial annuities may help make nest eggs last, new research finds.
